title.narrative: Activity under preparation Addressing global challenges in Greenland: economic diversification, green and digital transitions and resilience

description.narrative: This Action constitutes the first operational component of the EU¿Greenland Investment Package announced by the President of the European Commission and contributes to the implementation of the renewed EU¿Greenland partnership under the current Multiannual Financial Framework (MFF). The Action supports Greenland¿s green and digital transitions and economic diversification by combining targeted infrastructure investments, investment-enabling support and institutional capacity strengthening. It focuses on four complementary areas: satellite connectivity, renewable hybrid energy solutions in remote settlements, support to sustainable raw materials value chains, and the strengthening of Greenland¿s capacity to prepare, coordinate and implement EU-supported programmes and investments and advance key policy areas of cooperation. In the field of digital connectivity, the Action supports the reinforcement of geostationary (GEO) and low-earth orbit (LEO) satellite capacities in Greenland, with a focus on remote settlements. This will improve service quality, resilience and redundancy, while supporting the uptake of high-quality, secure and sustainable connectivity solutions in compliance with applicable regulatory frameworks. In the energy sector, the action supports the deployment of Greenland¿s Energy Sector Plan focused on transitioning from a heavy reliance on imported oil, by supporting the deployment of hybrid diesel-photovoltaic-battery solutions in remote settlements currently dependent on diesel-based micro-grids. In the field of raw materials, the Action reinforces targeted technical assistance through a top-up of the Overseas Countries and Territories (OCT) window of the Critical Raw Materials Facility. Finally, the action aims at supporting the strengthening of implementation and coordination functions within the Greenlandic administration as an enabling mechanism to ensure effective delivery of relevant policy priorities of the EU¿Greenland Partnership.
